legend.partial: implemented; holds for some rules only

validation.how: Every model input comes from a fit that used only earlier games; ratings for week W use weeks < W plus the prior season at 40% weight.
validation.note: Implemented in pipeline/build_all.py; the backtest has no look-ahead.

validation.gate: Observed price on every scored bet
validation.how: A bet is scored only when the source carries a price for that side; no -110 is assumed.
validation.note: 2,477 games in 2006-2026 carry no spread price and are excluded, not filled.

validation.how: Below 200, a run of luck is indistinguishable from skill at plausible effect sizes.
validation.note: Smallest rule on the priced board has 273 bets.

validation.gate: Hit rate beats the break-even implied by the actual prices
validation.how: Break-even is the mean implied probability of the prices actually taken, not 0.5.
validation.note: True for S07 and the model-total rules; false for the rest.

validation.how: Benjamini-Hochberg across all 12 tested rules at q<0.05.
validation.note: Best raw p is 0.198 (S07); the only p below 0.05 (S09, 0.015) is negative.

validation.how: 2024+2025 were never used to set thresholds.
validation.note: Only S07 is positive in the holdout (+26.3% on 44 bets); every model rule is negative.

validation.how: A per-season ROI table is published for every rule.
validation.note: S07 is positive in roughly half its seasons; no rule clears the stability bar.

validation.gate: Bootstrap interval on ROI excludes zero
validation.how: 10,000 resamples of the actual bet log.
validation.note: The interval includes zero for every rule after correction.
